title: Australia's ARIA says songs created mostly or entirely by AI will be excluded from its charts; a song that used AI became the most-played song on radio in July (Cam Wilson/ABC)
summary: Cam Wilson / ABC: Australia's ARIA says songs created mostly or entirely by AI will be excluded from its charts; a song that used AI became the most-played song on radio in July — In short: — Australia's main music charts have announced a ban on AI-generated music to start this week.
